"""
Command abstractions for decomposition (AT41).

This module introduces Command interface and concrete command classes
to replace direct orchestration logic in whisper_ctranslate2.py.
"""

import abc
import os
import sys
from typing import Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Union

from .commandline import CommandLine
from .diarization import Diarization
from .exit_code import ExitCode
from .live import Live
from .transcribe import Transcribe, TranscriptionOptions
from .writers import get_writer


class Command(abc.ABC):
    """Interface for command classes that encapsulate specific execution modes."""

    def __init__(self, args: Dict[str, str]):
        self.args = args

    @abc.abstractmethod
    def execute(self) -> None:
        """Execute the command logic."""
        raise NotImplementedError


class TranscribeCommand(Command):
    """Handles file-based transcription."""

    def execute(self) -> None:
        args = self.args
        output_dir = args.pop("output_dir")
        output_format = args.pop("output_format")
        model = args.pop("model")
        threads = args.pop("threads")
        language = args.pop("language")
        task = args.pop("task")
        device = args.pop("device")
        compute_type = args.pop("compute_type")
        verbose = args.pop("verbose")
        model_directory = args.pop("model_directory")
        cache_directory = args.pop("model_dir")
        device_index = args.pop("device_index")
        audio = args.pop("audio")
        local_files_only = args.pop("local_files_only")
        hf_token = args.pop("hf_token")
        speaker_name = args.pop("speaker_name")
        speaker_num = args.pop("speaker_num")
        batched = args.pop("batched")
        batch_size = args.pop("batch_size")

        # Rebuild transcription options from remaining args
        temperature = args.pop("temperature")
        increment = args.pop("temperature_increment_on_fallback")
        suppress_tokens = args.pop("suppress_tokens")
        word_timestamps = args.pop("word_timestamps")
        print_colors = args.pop("print_colors")
        vad_filter = args.pop("vad_filter")
        multilingual = args.pop("multilingual")
        from .transcribe import TranscriptionOptions
        from .languages import from_language_to_iso_code
        import numpy as np

        if increment is not None:
            temperature = tuple(np.arange(temperature, 1.0 + 1e-6, increment))
        else:
            temperature = [temperature]

        if suppress_tokens is None or len(suppress_tokens) == 0:
            suppress_tokens = []
        else:
            suppress_tokens = [int(t) for t in suppress_tokens.split(",")]

        options = TranscriptionOptions(
            beam_size=args.pop("beam_size"),
            best_of=args.pop("best_of"),
            patience=args.pop("patience"),
            length_penalty=args.pop("length_penalty"),
            repetition_penalty=args.pop("repetition_penalty"),
            no_repeat_ngram_size=args.pop("no_repeat_ngram_size"),
            log_prob_threshold=args.pop("logprob_threshold"),
            no_speech_threshold=args.pop("no_speech_threshold"),
            compression_ratio_threshold=args.pop("compression_ratio_threshold"),
            condition_on_previous_text=args.pop("condition_on_previous_text"),
            temperature=temperature,
            prompt_reset_on_temperature=args.pop("prompt_reset_on_temperature"),
            initial_prompt=args.pop("initial_prompt"),
            prefix=args.pop("prefix"),
            hotwords=args.pop("hotwords"),
            suppress_blank=args.pop("suppress_blank"),
            suppress_tokens=suppress_tokens,
            word_timestamps=word_timestamps,
            prepend_punctuations=args.pop("prepend_punctuations"),
            append_punctuations=args.pop("append_punctuations"),
            print_colors=print_colors,
            hallucination_silence_threshold=args.pop("hallucination_silence_threshold"),
            vad_filter=vad_filter,
            vad_threshold=args.pop("vad_threshold"),
            vad_min_speech_duration_ms=args.pop("vad_min_speech_duration_ms"),
            vad_max_speech_duration_s=args.pop("vad_max_speech_duration_s"),
            vad_min_silence_duration_ms=args.pop("vad_min_silence_duration_ms"),
            multilingual=multilingual,
        )

        # Language detection
        language = from_language_to_iso_code(language)
        if (
            not model_directory
            and model.endswith(".en")
            and language not in {"en", "English"}
        ):
            if language is not None:
                sys.stderr.write(
                    f"{model} is an English-only model but received '{language}'; using English instead.\n"
                )
            language = "en"

        # Validate arguments
        word_options = [
            "highlight_words",
            "max_line_count",
            "max_line_width",
            "max_words_per_line",
        ]
        if not options.word_timestamps:
            for option in word_options:
                if args.get(option, False):
                    sys.stderr.write(f"--{option} requires --word_timestamps True\n")
                    return

        if options.hallucination_silence_threshold and not options.word_timestamps:
            sys.stderr.write(
                "--hallucination_silence_threshold requires --word_timestamps True\n"
            )
            return

        if batch_size and not batched:
            sys.stderr.write("--batch_size can only be used if --batched is True\n")
            return

        if args.get("max_line_count") and not args.get("max_line_width"):
            import warnings
            warnings.warn("--max_line_count has no effect without --max_line_width")

        if args.get("max_words_per_line") and args.get("max_line_width"):
            warnings.warn("--max_words_per_line has no effect with --max_line_width")

        writer_options = list(word_options)
        writer_options.append("pretty_json")
        writer_args = {arg: args.pop(arg) for arg in writer_options}

        if not verbose and print_colors:
            sys.stderr.write("You cannot disable verbose and enable print colors\n")
            return

        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

        if model_directory:
            model_filename = os.path.join(model_directory, "model.bin")
            if not os.path.exists(model_filename):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Model file '{model_filename}' does not exist\n")
                return
            model_dir = model_directory
        else:
            model_dir = model

        try:
            transcribe_model = Transcribe(
                model_dir,
                device,
                device_index,
                compute_type,
                threads,
                cache_directory,
                local_files_only,
                batched,
                batch_size,
            )
        except RuntimeError as e:
            print(f"error: {e}")
            sys.exit(ExitCode.RUNTIME_ERROR)

        diarization = len(hf_token) > 0
        diarization_output = {}

        if diarization:
            diarization_device = "cpu" if device == "auto" else device
            diarize_model = Diarization(
                token=hf_token, device=diarization_device, num_speakers=speaker_num
            )
            if threads > 0:
                diarize_model.set_threads(threads)

        if diarization:
            import datetime
            for audio_path in audio:
                if verbose and len(audio) > 1:
                    print(f"\nFile: '{audio_path}' (diarization)")

                start_time = datetime.datetime.now()
                diarize_segments = diarize_model.run_model(audio_path)
                diarization_output[audio_path] = diarize_segments
                if verbose:
                    print(f"Time used for diarization: {datetime.datetime.now() - start_time}")

            diarize_model.unload_model()

        for audio_path in audio:
            try:
                if verbose and len(audio) > 1:
                    print(f"\nFile: '{audio_path} ({task})'")

                import datetime
                start_time = datetime.datetime.now()
                result = transcribe_model.inference(
                    audio_path,
                    task,
                    language,
                    verbose,
                    False,
                    options,
                )

                if diarization:
                    if verbose:
                        print(
                            f"Time used for transcription: {datetime.datetime.now() - start_time}"
                        )
                    result = diarize_model.assign_speakers_to_segments(
                        diarization_output[audio_path], result, speaker_name
                    )

                writer = get_writer(output_format, output_dir)
                writer(result, audio_path, writer_args)

            except Exception as e:
                import traceback
                error_details = traceback.format_exc()
                sys.stderr.write(
                    f"Error: Unable to process file: {audio_path}\n"
                    f"Exception Type: {type(e).__name__}\n"
                    f"Exception Message: {e}\n"
                    f"Traceback:\n{error_details}\n"
                )
                continue

        if verbose:
            print(f"Transcription results written to '{output_dir}' directory")


class LiveCommand(Command):
    """Handles live transcription."""

    def execute(self) -> None:
        args = self.args
        model = args.pop("model")
        threads = args.pop("threads")
        language = args.pop("language")
        task = args.pop("task")
        device = args.pop("device")
        compute_type = args.pop("compute_type")
        verbose = args.pop("verbose")
        model_directory = args.pop("model_directory")
        cache_directory = args.pop("model_dir")
        device_index = args.pop("device_index")
        local_files_only = args.pop("local_files_only")
        live_volume_threshold = args.pop("live_volume_threshold")
        live_input_device = args.pop("live_input_device")
        live_input_device_sample_rate = args.pop("live_input_device_sample_rate")
        
        from .transcribe import TranscriptionOptions
        import numpy as np
        
        temperature = args.pop("temperature")
        increment = args.pop("temperature_increment_on_fallback")
        suppress_tokens = args.pop("suppress_tokens")
        word_timestamps = args.pop("word_timestamps")
        print_colors = args.pop("print_colors")
        vad_filter = args.pop("vad_filter")
        multilingual = args.pop("multilingual")

        if increment is not None:
            temperature = tuple(np.arange(temperature, 1.0 + 1e-6, increment))
        else:
            temperature = [temperature]

        if suppress_tokens is None or len(suppress_tokens) == 0:
            suppress_tokens = []
        else:
            suppress_tokens = [int(t) for t in suppress_tokens.split(",")]

        options = TranscriptionOptions(
            beam_size=args.pop("beam_size"),
            best_of=args.pop("best_of"),
            patience=args.pop("patience"),
            length_penalty=args.pop("length_penalty"),
            repetition_penalty=args.pop("repetition_penalty"),
            no_repeat_ngram_size=args.pop("no_repeat_ngram_size"),
            log_prob_threshold=args.pop("logprob_threshold"),
            no_speech_threshold=args.pop("no_speech_threshold"),
            compression_ratio_threshold=args.pop("compression_ratio_threshold"),
            condition_on_previous_text=args.pop("condition_on_previous_text"),
            temperature=temperature,
            prompt_reset_on_temperature=args.pop("prompt_reset_on_temperature"),
            initial_prompt=args.pop("initial_prompt"),
            prefix=args.pop("prefix"),
            hotwords=args.pop("hotwords"),
            suppress_blank=args.pop("suppress_blank"),
            suppress_tokens=suppress_tokens,
            word_timestamps=word_timestamps,
            prepend_punctuations=args.pop("prepend_punctuations"),
            append_punctuations=args.pop("append_punctuations"),
            print_colors=print_colors,
            hallucination_silence_threshold=args.pop("hallucination_silence_threshold"),
            vad_filter=vad_filter,
            vad_threshold=args.pop("vad_threshold"),
            vad_min_speech_duration_ms=args.pop("vad_min_speech_duration_ms"),
            vad_max_speech_duration_s=args.pop("vad_max_speech_duration_s"),
            vad_min_silence_duration_ms=args.pop("vad_min_silence_duration_ms"),
            multilingual=multilingual,
        )

        if not Live.is_available():
            Live.force_not_available_exception()

        if model_directory:
            model_dir = model_directory
        else:
            model_dir = model

        Live(
            model_dir,
            cache_directory,
            local_files_only,
            task,
            language,
            threads,
            device,
            device_index,
            compute_type,
            verbose,
            live_volume_threshold,
            live_input_device,
            live_input_device_sample_rate,
            options,
        ).inference()
